about_the_game:
The Blippo+ Original Soundtrack features 137 tracks of pure Blippian music, from the theme songs of every Blippo+ show and the loopable bops of The Electronic Program Guide to the Menu and Messages music and all the top tunes from Planet Blip itself — as showcased on Party Music Nonstop!

In a world without money, art is the only currency, and Blippians spend it well, with jangly jingles and adorable earworms that will put pep your in step. In fact, there’s no better way to Get Bent than to take this journey through Planet Blip’s sonic soundscapes!

The Blippo+ Original Soundtrack was composed by Grammy-nominated producers Rob Kieswetter and Jona Bechtolt of the band YACHT.
